Clinical Program Manager, Nursing Operations
Fennel & Finch
Location: San Francisco, CA (onsite, 4 days per week)
Employment type: Full-time

About Fennel & Finch

Fennel & Finch is a consumer health and wellness platform. Through our website and app, people can connect with licensed healthcare providers for care across areas such as dermatology, sexual health, mental health and weight management, and get prescribed treatments delivered to their door. Our clinical organization supports a network of providers and clinical staff who care for patients through telehealth.

About the role

We're hiring a Clinical Program Manager to build and run nursing operations programs that support our providers and patients. You'll own programs end to end, from the first workflow draft to launch and ongoing measurement. Examples include patient follow-up programs, clinical escalation pathways, and nurse support for new care categories.

This role sits on our Clinical Operations team in our San Francisco office and works closely with medical leadership, product, operations and compliance. We collaborate in person: the team is in the office Monday through Thursday. This role is not open to remote candidates. Relocation assistance is available for candidates moving to the Bay Area.

What you'll do

- Design and launch nursing operations programs, including workflows, escalation pathways, staffing needs and training.
- Write and maintain clinical protocols and standard work in partnership with medical leadership and compliance.
- Define success metrics for each program and build the reporting to track them; review results with leadership monthly.
- Run process improvement work using data, chart audits and frontline feedback.
- Partner with product teams to shape tools used by clinicians and care teams; write requirements and run user acceptance testing.
- Coordinate launches of new care categories across clinical, operations and support teams.
- Train clinical staff on new programs and workflows.
- Track risks and keep cross-functional partners aligned on timelines.

What you bring

- Active RN license.
- 6+ years of clinical nursing experience, including acute care or ambulatory care.
- Experience leading a clinical program, quality improvement project or system implementation from start to finish.
- Experience building workflows and training staff on new processes.
- Comfort with data and spreadsheets; ability to define metrics and explain trends to non-clinical partners.
- Excellent written communication; you can turn complex clinical processes into clear guides.
- Ability to work onsite in our San Francisco office four days per week.

Nice to have

- Telehealth or virtual care experience.
- Experience with EHR implementations or optimization, including super-user or trainer roles.
- Charge nurse or unit leadership experience.
- Familiarity with SQL or BI tools such as Looker or Tableau.
- Experience working with product and engineering teams.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $125,000 to $150,000 per year, plus equity and benefits. Benefits include medical, dental and vision coverage, a 401(k), paid time off, paid parental leave and commuter benefits.

Travel

Minimal travel, under 5%.

Work authorization

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States.

Fennel & Finch is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other protected characteristic.
